title: "Flying Saucer News in Brief" newsletter pp. 14-15: 1966 conventions and book offers
description: Two-page spread of printed newsletter text headed "FLYING SAUCER NEWS IN BRIEF," pages 14 and 15. Items cover "Coming 1966 Flying Saucer Conventions" with dates and venues, short news notes about contactee groups, and a list of "New Books Now Available From AFSCA" with prices. The pages are entirely text with no photographs or illustrations.
